steps.caption: Mail alerts
steps.narration: This is Mail alerts. It keeps the provider emails that matter, matched to the client they're about.

steps.caption: Provider inbox
steps.narration: Alert emails from Google, Cloudflare and domain registrars land in the Provider inbox.

steps.caption: Severity, client, sender
steps.narration: Each alert shows how serious it is, the client it's about, the sender, and when it arrived.

steps.caption: Critical first
steps.narration: The counts at the top are filters. Choose Critical to see what needs you first.

steps.caption: Two critical alerts
steps.narration: Here, a suggested edit to a Business Profile, and a domain about to expire.

steps.caption: Back to all alerts
steps.narration: Choose it again to clear the filter.

steps.caption: Unmapped
steps.narration: Unmapped lists the alerts that aren't matched to a client yet.

steps.caption: Assign client
steps.narration: To file one, choose Assign client.

steps.caption: Pick the client
steps.narration: Pick the client it belongs to.

steps.caption: Map selected alerts
steps.narration: Then choose Map selected alerts. It leaves the Unmapped list.

steps.caption: All alerts
steps.narration: Back on the full list, open any alert to read the email itself.

steps.caption: Read matched message
steps.narration: Choose Read matched message. Opening it marks the alert read.

steps.caption: Filter and search
steps.narration: You can also filter by provider, severity or client, or search. Alerts are kept for thirty days.

steps.caption: Menu: Mail alerts
steps.narration: You'll find Mail alerts in the menu on the left, under Google Business, next to Domains.

youtube.title: Mail alerts in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Mail alerts in ConstructHUB: alert emails from Google, Cloudflare and domain registrars in one inbox, marked by severity, filtered to what is critical or unread, and matched to the client each one is about.
